name: Replace Text
description: Replace all instances of matched text in an existing document. Supports Markdown formatting in the replacement text. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request#ReplaceAllTextRequest)

configurable_props.name: docId
configurable_props.label: Document
configurable_props.description: Search for and select a document. You can also use a custom expression to pass a value from a previous step (e.g., `{{steps.foo.$return_value.documentId}}`) or you can enter a static ID (e.g., `1KuEN7k8jVP3Qi0_svM5OO8oEuiLkq0csihobF67eat8`).

configurable_props.name: replaced
configurable_props.label: Text to be replaced
configurable_props.description: The text that will be replaced

configurable_props.name: text
configurable_props.label: New Text
configurable_props.description: The replacement text. Can include Markdown formatting (bold, italic, code, links, headings, lists, etc.).

configurable_props.name: enableMarkdown
configurable_props.label: Parse as Markdown
configurable_props.description: Enable Markdown parsing for the replacement text. When enabled, Markdown syntax (e.g., **bold**, *italic*, [links](url), `code`) will be converted to Google Docs formatting.

configurable_props.name: matchCase
configurable_props.label: Match Case
configurable_props.description: Case sensitive search (`true`) or not (`false`). Defaults to `false`

configurable_props.name: tabIds
configurable_props.label: Tab IDs
configurable_props.description: The tab IDs to replace the text in
